items.title: Cops Are Pushing Extremely Corny ‘Grand Theft Auto 6’ Slop
items.summary: The blockbuster game makes no secret of its contempt for law enforcement. Real police departments using it to recruit new members and scold the public apparently didn’t get the memo.
items.author: Miles Klee

items.title: Jensen Huang’s ‘Lying’ Alarmed Nvidia Board Ahead of His Resignation
items.summary: Amid allegations of multiple affairs, including with a direct report and an alleged Chinese intelligence asset, sources tell WIRED the Nvidia board’s main issue was the former CEO’s “lack of candor.”
items.author: Lauren Goode, Paresh Dave

items.title: Muse Is Unleashing a World of Pettiness on Instagram
items.summary: Meta’s AI assistant can track and unfollow Instagram users who don’t follow you back—and some people are taking full advantage.
items.author: Jason Parham

items.title: Regular Tech Bros Are Worried About Honeypots
items.summary: The Jensen Huang scandal is the latest fuel for dating anxieties among newly rich and powerful tech workers.
items.author: Kate Taylor, Caroline Haskins

items.title: This 16-Year-Old Founded an AI Missile Startup. He’s Targeting ‘Cost per Kill’
items.summary: Henrijs Dandzbergs dropped out of high school to join startup accelerator Y Combinator. With a new breed of missile, he wants to make killing as efficient as possible for the US and its military allies.
items.author: Joel Khalili
